where.if: (l.masked_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.masked_login_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.reason LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR CAST(l.user_id AS CHAR) = #{keyword})

mapper.select:
SELECT l.log_id AS logId, l.user_id AS userId, l.masked_name AS maskedName, l.masked_login_id AS maskedLoginId, l.member_type AS memberType, l.reason, l.withdrawn_by AS withdrawnBy, a.name AS withdrawnByName, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_withdraw_log l LEFT JOIN users a ON a.user_id = l.withdrawn_by
ORDER BY l.created_at DESC, l.log_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
